eligibility.quote:
I was just debugging a script for controlling a vehicle and was having trouble with sequencing. And I found that the set_mode service [always returns true](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/cafb05e79697fc8f1cb889ffac9e5b9d68183460/mavros/src/plugins/sys_status.cpp#L951) whether or not the state transtion was accepted. 

It might fail if the state is invalid but doesn't fail otherwise.

failed_conditions.quote: I found that the set_mode service [always returns true](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/cafb05e79697fc8f1cb889ffac9e5b9d68183460/mavros/src/plugins/sys_status.cpp#L951) whether or not the state transtion was accepted.

Yes, for some reasons `success` only show mode parsing status ([it may be one from list](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/cafb05e79697fc8f1cb889ffac9e5b9d68183460/mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp#L32), or numeric).
Unfortunately there are no reliable method to wait AP response.

resolution.quote: msgs fix #625: Rename SetMode.Response.success to mode_sent

notes: Independently verified. (1) E1: issue #625 body (tfoote, 2016-11-08, title 'set_mode service always returns true') matches the spec's condition quote verbatim including the link to sys_status.cpp#L951 at cafb05e; maintainer vooon's comment 259057790 matches verbatim, including the recommended mode monitoring ('So you should implement mode monitoring in your node: a. Subscribe to `~state` and check mode ... b. Call `~set_mode` and wait mode change.'). (2) E2: broken-side provider behavior read directly in the fix commit 599c588's diff context at the send site: 'UAS_FCU(m_uas)->send_message_ignore_drop(sm);' followed by '-			res.success = true;' — the provider sets success after parse-and-send only, so the wrong value crosses the service boundary; the consumer (reporter's script, separately deployable process) reads it as the mode-change outcome. Service interface kind, stop at 6 — agreed; not build/packaging (the fix changes the service definition and code), not deployment wiring. (3) Class 'other' for both conditions: definition, type and name match on both sides; the mismatch is the semantics of the value carried by SetMode.Response.success — no named class covers it. Implicated elements (service + field / field) are right. (4) Loudness silent_documented/run: the service call succeeds and returns a value; discovered while debugging sequencing; no tooling diagnostic. (5) Fix commit 599c588 (2017-06-28) read directly: SetMode.srv '-bool success' -> '+bool mode_sent		# Mode known/parsed correctly and SET_MODE are sent', sys_status.cpp 'res.success' -> 'res.mode_sent' (both the false and true paths), scripts mavsys/mavsetp 'ret.success' -> 'ret.mode_sent' — matches the spec's resolution summary. Status recommended: the reporter's composition is never shown working (the rename only relabels the semantics; the reporter's script revision is unknown/not public).
